title: Will AI reduce your work? It adds work: managing it.
caption: AI takes over the execution and hands you the management, and that is what lets one person take on far more complex work.
description: Why AI adds work rather than removing it, and the management skills that let you take on far more complex tasks with it: hand off work with enough context, onboard a new team member like a new AI session, and break a complex project into chunks with clear seams between them.
